steps.code:
# Fetch all pages of friends
all_friends = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.search_friends(access_token=login_response['access_token'], page_limit=20, page_index=page_index)
    if not page:
        break
    all_friends.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
    if len(page) < 20:
        break

print(f"Total friends fetched: {len(all_friends)}")

steps.code:
# Count friends made since October 1, 2022
from datetime import datetime
start_date = datetime(2022, 10, 1)
count = 0
for friend in all_friends:
    friends_since = datetime.fromisoformat(friend['friends_since'])
    if friends_since >= start_date:
        count += 1
